[RFCS.15.2] The `CallIssued` body is defined in
`proto/call_issued.proto#CallIssued`. The recorder is its only producer; it
leaves field 1, `call_id`, absent.

**The arguments are typed and named.** `args` holds one `Arg` ([RFCS.23.2]) per
kwarg the call supplies, sorted by kwarg name; an optional kwarg the call omits
is absent, not `null`. A kwarg declared with a schema or with `Schema`
([LADP.8.6.1]) is an `Arg` of kind `KIND_ENCODED_FACT` carrying the bound fact
as a `FactExternal` ([RFCS.23.1]). The call callback ([NCBK.6.2]) and the
`DS_EV_ACTION_CALL` event carry the same arguments.

**Joins.** `(timetag, rule_name)` is the firing activation's identity:
`RuleFireAnnotation` ([RFCS.11.2]) carries the byte-identical pair, so a
recorded `CallIssued` resolves to the `RuleFireAnnotation` bracketing it.
`correlation` joins it forward to the answers it will (or will not) receive.
`correlation` is always present and never empty ([LCRS.3.1]): the author's
`as` string, or the per-activation value the compiler generated
([LCCO.3.4]).
